walkthroughs.body_html:
The UK has a clear upland-lowland split.

The Tees-Exe line runs from the mouth of the Tees to the Exe estuary.

North-west of it = uplands. South-east of it = lowlands.

Rocks shape the land.

Igneous rocks like granite are tough and form high tors.

Sedimentary rocks like chalk shape rolling lowlands.

Metamorphic rocks form deep underground.

Heat and pressure change shale into slate, as quarried in Snowdonia.

Each rock weathers and erodes at different rates.

mcqs.q: What weather does an anticyclone (high pressure system) bring?
options: Descending air warms and dries, suppressing cloud formation — so anticyclones bring clear, settled weather: hot in summer, cold and frosty in winter.
Anticyclones bring heavy rainfall because they trap moisture.
High pressure brings stormy weather because the air pushes down hard.
